description: This file defines an abstract base class 'UiTestBase' for UI tests using NUnit framework. It handles setup and teardown of WebDriver instances, loading configuration settings, and provides a method to skip tests in discovery-only mode.

classes.name: UiTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for UI tests, managing WebDriver setup and teardown, loading settings, and providing a method to skip tests in discovery-only mode.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes settings and creates WebDriver instance if enabled, called before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Disposes of WebDriver after each test, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: SkipIfDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Skips the test if discovery-only mode is enabled, to avoid launching a browser.
